title: Greez Dritus
description: Greez Dritus was a skilled pilot. Like all Latero, Dritus had four arms, which greatly enhanced his ability to handle a ship. As captain of the Stinger Mantis, he flew the ship that carried Cere Junda and the rest of the crew on the hunt for the Jedi Holocron. After the group survived their encounter with Darth Vader and destroyed the Holocron, they decided to stay together on Dritus's ship.
